Thank you for suggesting an idea. Please open an issue and reach agreement here before sending a pull request — this protects your time as much as the project's.

## The problem

What user-visible problem are you trying to solve? Whose workflow is broken or awkward today?

## The proposal

What would you like Carryover to do? Sketch the behavior, the surface area (CLI, hook, config file, AGENTS.md block, etc.), and the user-facing change.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Scope check

- [ ] This proposal does not require the AI agent to summarize, save, or restore its own state inside a prompt. (Carryover is contextless-design — bookkeeping happens locally so the agent never sees it.)
- [ ] This proposal fits within the in-scope items in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), or it is a documented v0.2 / v0.3 item from [`ROADMAP.md`](../../ROADMAP.md).

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in other tools, screenshots, or anything else useful.
